generate_batch_with_fastgpt: generate text completions for a batch of prompts using the FastGPT class with configurable temperature and max tokens
run_speculative_decoding: run speculative decoding with a draft model to accelerate token generation in the FastGPT generate method
decode_tokens_autoregressively: decode N tokens autoregressively from a model using decode_n_tokens with optional early stop on EOS
prefill_prompt_and_sample: prefill a prompt through the model and sample the first token using the prefill method
sample_from_logits: sample tokens from model logits using temperature and top-k sampling via the sample and logits_to_probs methods
